name: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
benefit: > **Financial Assistance for Medical Education** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹20,000/- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses. > **Financial Assistance for Other Graduate Courses** Direct Benefit Transfer of ₹10,000/- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a child of a worker employed in a factory or institution in Gujarat state. - The applicant must have passed 12th Standard board examination in the respective year. - The applicant must have secured 70% or above percentile in 12th Standard board examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery or any other graduate level course. - The applicant must ensure that their parent is working in a factory or institution located in Gujarat state. - The applicant must ensure that their parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year continuously. - The applicant must submit the application by the last date of February of the respective year. - The applicant must have completed 12th Standard examination specifically in the respective year.
